messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

We're ready for board approval. The terms are settled: 4.5m upfront, 5.5m milestones, 6.5%/4.0% royalty, 750k minimum, 125% cap. I can attend the 9 January board by phone to take the directors through the resolutions if helpful. We aim to sign on 22 January.

Sarah
